title: Political & National Affairs Correspondent
bio: Aisha covers Parliament, the central ministries and the decisions that ripple out to every state. Formerly a Lok Sabha reporter and radio producer, she is happiest with a briefing document, a strong cup of chai and a deadline that is already too close.

title: Sports Editor
bio: Arjun has reported from the Chepauk, the Chinnaswamy and more rain-delayed local grounds than he can count. He leads Bharat Wire's coverage of cricket, kabaddi, football and the club stories that never make the national bulletins.

title: Culture & What's On Editor
bio: Meera curates the cinema, music, festival and street-food life of the country, from a Kollywood premiere to a Carnatic concert in a hall with no air conditioning. She is a lapsed classical dancer and a recovering film critic.

title: Business & Technology Correspondent
bio: Priya follows the money: startups, IPOs, the RBI, housing and the jobs announcements that change a city. A former equity analyst, she reads company filings for fun and explains them so nobody else has to.

title: Regional & Community Editor
bio: Rohan runs the regional desk and the community reporting programme. He believes the best local news is reported by the people who live there, checked by editors who care, and never sensationalised. Ask him about municipal road repairs at your peril.
